remarks: Best and final Wed 7/30 at 12 noon Stunning and immaculate Heywood Heights first floor condo overlooks gardens and offers a 1 car garage right across from the building! Architect-designed, high end renovation creates an open feel yet maintains the integrity of the living, dining, and kitchen spaces. Updates include a custom kitchen with granite countertops, newer appliances and mechanicals, hardwood floors, baths, and custom window treatments. The condo offers privacy as the condo looks out on lawn - not into someone else's living room. Additional storage is easily accessed in the basement. Well-maintained, pet friendly complex also offers a lovely pool and lots of green space. Convenient to all that Stamford offers. Shopping, Public Transportation, Chelsea Piers & Cove Island Park.
